name: Silky Carrot Ginger Pureed Soup Base (No Garlic/Onion)
whyItWorks: Fresh peeled carrots simmered in chicken bone broth with freshly grated ginger juice and sea salt, blended until velvety smooth. Renowned gut-calming dish rich in soluble pectin and gingerol.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1 lb peeled sliced carrots in 3 cups bone broth with 1 tsp fresh ginger juice for 20 minutes. Blend until silky smooth and pass through a fine sieve.
